name: bookleaf-author-support
description: BookLeaf Author Support and Communication Portal

scripts.dev: npm run setup && npm run build -w @bookleaf/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @bookleaf/shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bookleaf/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @bookleaf/shared && npm run seed -w backend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bookleaf/shared && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w @bookleaf/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bookleaf/shared && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
